chunks.title: Spring Boot Maven Multi-stage Dockerfile
chunks.content:
Spring Boot Maven Multi-stage Dockerfile

Multi-stage Dockerfile for a Spring Boot service built with Maven. Build stage: maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-17 — copies pom.xml and mvnw, runs mvnw -DskipTests package. Runtime stage: eclipse-temurin:17-jre — copies compiled JAR, exposes 8080, ENTRYPOINT java -jar /app/app.jar.

Decision rules:
- Use when language=java, framework=spring_boot, runtime=maven
- Multi-stage separates build tools from the runtime image, significantly reducing final image size
- Use eclipse-temurin:17-jre (JRE only, not JDK) in runtime stage

Trade-offs:
- Build time is longer due to Maven dependency resolution, mitigated by caching pom.xml separately
- mvnw wrapper must exist in project root; fall back to mvn if absent

Anti-patterns:
- Do not use a JDK image in the runtime stage — use JRE to minimize attack surface
- Do not skip -DskipTests if test failures should gate the build
